newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong air cargo set for another record.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong air cargo set for another record.

text.p: Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Limited (HACTL) says it is on course for another record year with a 7.1 per cent increase in throughput during September.

HACTL statistics show that exports rose 5.5 per cent to 68,673 tonnes, imports increased 7.3 per cent to 49,063 tonnes and transhipments rose 13.7 per cent to 16,775 tonnes compared to September last year.

Cumulatively, HACTL says it is 4 per cent ahead of the first nine months of 1995 with exports 2.8 per cent higher at 484,874 tonnes, imports up 6 per cent at 442,137 tonnes and transhipments increasing 1.9 per cent to 125,826 tonnes.

"We expect to see significant increases in throughput over the next few months as factories is Hong Kong and southern China gear up for the peak Christmas season," Anthony Charter, HACTL's managing director said in a statement.
"Our overall total of 1,052,837 tonnes for the first nine months of this year leaves us well placed to set another air cargo handling record again in 1996," he added.

HACTL, which has a monopoly on all air cargo handling at Kai Tak airport, is jointly owned by Swire Pacific Ltd, Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd, Wharf (Holdings) Ltd, Hutchison Whampoa Ltd, China National Aviation Corp, CITIC Pacific Ltd and Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
